evidence.quote: We will need to be patient to achieve the outcomes set out in our guidance.
These changes mean that we will not tighten monetary policy solely in response to a strong labor market.
A burst of transitory inflation seems more probable than a durable shift above target in the inflation trend and an unmooring of inflation expectations to the upside.
the unemployment rate is close to 10 percent currently—much higher than the headline unemployment rate of 6.3 percent.
asset purchases are expected to continue at least at their current pace until substantial further progress has been made toward our goals.
Today the economy remains far from our goals in terms of both employment and inflation, and it will take some time to achieve substantial further progress.

parsed.rationale: The speaker stresses that the economy is far from goals, that inflation pressures will be transitory, and that policy must remain patient with continued asset purchases and no preemptive tightening. A brief acknowledgment of a strong 2021 outlook and willingness to act on persistent inflation only slightly tempers the strongly dovish message.
